AllPossibleMonsters.maps_to: none -- the sim has no per-encounter monster-preview member

ExtraAssetPaths.maps_to: none -- headless sim has no asset-path/overlay-rendering layer
ExtraAssetPaths.rationale: VineShamblerNormal.ExtraAssetPaths preloads the Entangled affliction's overlay sprite. TangledPower (the sim's Entangled-equivalent, applied by GRASPING_VINES) is ported; only the visual overlay asset is out of scope for a headless sim.

GenerateMonsters.note: C# GenerateMonsters is a single-element list [(VineShambler, null)], zero draws; VineShamblerNormal has no Slots override either. The sim's plain Encounter with one monster class matches exactly.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.maps_to: structural: Encounter is never registered with HookSystem

Tags.note: No Tags override in C# (default empty).

MinGoldReward.note: Poverty multiplier out of scope, not applied in roll_gold_reward.
